Editor now mounts without ErrorBoundary, autosaves to Firestore, content survives reload, mobile More-tools dropdown works and applies blockquote, desktop More-tools is hidden and inline toolbar (bold via Ctrl+B → <strong>) is functional.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: two RichEditor instances are mounted on the /app/notes page simultaneously (verified — .ProseMirror count=2 and [data-testid='editor-more-tools'] count=2 while only one editor is visible on mobile bottom-sheet). Two live TipTap editors doubles memory, mounts two ProseMirror views and two autosave listeners per note open; consider lazy-mounting the mobile bottom-sheet editor only when isOpen, or reusing a single editor instance across the desktop/mobile layouts.

Persistent capacitor warning still logged in console: 'Capacitor plugin "ArshnazWidget" already registered. Cannot register plugins twice.' — cosmetic but worth guarding the plugin registration behind an if-not-registered check (unchanged from iteration_2).
seed_data_creation: Two persisted notes remain in Firestore for this user with markers 'PERSIST_RETEST_ARSHNAZ_98765' and 'PERSIST_RETEST_1790570106'. Safe to delete via the UI '...' menu on each note row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RichEditor crash is fully fixed by combined vite.config.ts dedupe + optimizeDeps.include of prosemirror-* AND the guarded/try-catch mount useEffect in RichEditor.tsx (~L110). Notes persist to Firestore per user; do not use rapid page.reload() loops behind the preview Cloudflare (429). When testing mobile editor UI, note that the notes page mounts TWO RichEditor instances (desktop split-pane + mobile bottom-sheet), so [data-testid='editor-more-tools'] returns count=2 and only nth(1) is visible at 390x844 — filter by is_visible() or bounding_box(). Persian numerals are used to render digits in note previews (۰-۹), so text-based locators for Latin numbers will miss them; match on the letter prefix (e.g., 'PERSIST_RETEST').
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_2 root cause was 'null (cached)' inside prosemirror-model DOMSerializer.fromSchema, caused by two ProseMirror module instances (Vite dev bundling loaded prosemirror-model twice — once via @tiptap/pm and once via direct import chains) so the schema-side cache on one instance was null when the other instance's serializer looked it up, PLUS RichEditor's post-mount useEffect calling editor.getHTML() before the view was fully created. Fix applied and verified: (a) vite.config.ts adds prosemirror-* to resolve.dedupe and optimizeDeps.include so only ONE ProseMirror model/state/view/transform is loaded; (b) the mount useEffect in RichEditor.tsx no longer calls getHTML(), only setContent when editor exists and !isDestroyed, wrapped in try/catch. Retest confirms the editor now mounts, saves, and persists across reloads with no ErrorBoundary.
